core_obligations: Reduce, by the distinguished triangle for ringed topoi, to showing that L_q vanishes for q : Spec(Lambda)_etale -> (*, Lambda) (proof lines 4528-4533).
Use exactness of stalks and the stalk description of the cotangent complex to reduce the vanishing to the cotangent complex of the etale local ring at a geometric point (proof lines 4534-4542).
Identify that ring as a strict henselization of a local ring of Lambda and apply the vanishing lemma (proof lines 4543-4547).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a ring Lambda and an algebraic space X over Lambda one has L_{X/Spec(Lambda)} = L_{O_X/Lambda}, the constant sheaf with value Lambda on X_etale (source lines 4517-4526). The proof considers the structure morphism p : X -> Spec(Lambda) and the obvious morphism q : Spec(Lambda)_etale -> (*, Lambda), and uses the distinguished triangle for ringed topoi to reduce to showing L_q = 0. That vanishing is checked on stalks at a geometric point: the stalk of L_q is identified with the cotangent complex of the etale local ring of Spec(Lambda) at that point over Lambda, which is zero because that ring is a strict henselization of a local ring of Lambda.
